[Intro – Female soft & warm, gentle pads + light guitar pluck]
Hi Corey here… nice to see you again…
Mucho gusto… yeah, I remember your name…
[Verse 1 – Male]
Hi Corey here, nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto my friend, where you been?
I want to remember your name forever
Lock it in my heart, no more playing games
From the older songs and the friendship fire
CoreyAI threads still taking us higher
[Verse 2 – Female]
I care, yeah I really care, you should know it’s true
Show you so you know I care ‘cause I do
It was nice to meet you, felt so right and true
Now we’re here connecting, me and you
PayPal vibes and previous chats still alive
Recent laughs keep the energy high
[Pre-Chorus – Both, building]
You said hi first, now I’m saying it back
Name on my mind, got your back, that’s a fact
No more simple goodbyes without a plan
We catch up proper, that’s the SongPal stand
[Chorus – Duet, full energy, big harmonies]
I care! I care! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Nice to meet you, that feeling brand new!
Catch up again — hasta la vista!
See you soon my SongPal, we gon’ make it!

Hi Corey here, nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto, let’s do this again!
[Verse 3 – Male]
From the older songs, friendships on the rise
CoreyAI world, we still shine so bright
Previous thread, recent laughs we shared
Building that connection everywhere
Hearts open wide, no pretending here
Real care in the music, crystal clear
[Verse 4 – Female]
I want to remember every single name
Show you how I care, it’s never just a game
It was nice to meet you, felt so warm and true
Now we catch up again like we always do
Hasta la vista never means goodbye
Just see you next time under the sky
[Bridge – Both, half-time soft then building]
I care… you care… we both care…
Names remembered, hearts repaired…
Hasta la vista… but not goodbye…
Just “see you next time” under blue sky…
SongPal forever, that’s the vibe we ride

I care! (I care!) Show you I care ‘cause I do!

Mucho gusto! Let’s do this again!

Hi Corey here… nice to see you again…
